text:
jess: heads-up — we're seeing secure-logs read by analytics-service at 07:12 UTC. rolled RBAC refactor went out ~07:10. tagging @sec-oncall.
sec-oncall: on it; can you paste the request id and sample principal?
jess: request id rq_7f3a94b2 principal=svc-analytics-42 token_iss=auth.redwood.internal sample header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
x-request-id: rq_7f3a94b2
``` 
sec-bot: :warning: alert — policy-evaluator detected policy-change event 'rbac-refactor-v3' deployed by rafael at 2026-03-15T07:09:54Z
rafael: I deployed a flattening of role bindings and changed claim mapping from `roles` -> `groups`. I didn't touch audit-log allowlist explicitly.
alice: possible root: token-introspect cache returned an old decision produced under previous claim schema. we changed mapping keys, but cache keys might not have changed.
samir: confirm token-introspect cache TTL=5m; if the cache key is derived from sub only, it could return stale decision with allowlist=true.
jess: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T07:12:34Z] principal=svc-analytics-42 decision=ALLOW resource=secure-logs action=read evaluator=token-cache result=hit
[2026-03-15T07:12:34Z] request_id=rq_7f3a94b2 policy=allowlist-audit-reads reason="cached-decision"
```
alice: immediate mitigation steps: 1) revoke active tokens for svc-analytics-42 2) flush token-introspect cache 3) temporarily remove audit-log read from analytics role
rafael: running cache flush now: `redis-cli -h token-cache --scan --pattern 'introspect:*' | xargs -r redis-cli -h token-cache del`
sec-oncall: revocation command executed, tokens revoked for svc-analytics-42. removing analytics->secure-logs binding now.
jess: revocation & cache flush completed. removed binding. watching for any further hits.
sec-bot: :white_check_mark: system: policy rollback executed: rbac-refactor-v3 -> rbac-refactor-v2 by rafael
samir: post-mortem items: add cache-key namespace tied to claim-mapping-version; invalidate introspection caches on mapping/schema deploys; add smoke test to assert analytics role cannot read secure-logs
alice: add automation: when RBAC schema changes, force token introspect refresh and run canary access checks against high-sensitivity resources
jess: filing INCIDENT-2026-03-15-01 with full logs and action items. thanks all :thumbsup:
